payload.entry: Verified in sase-github: template creates omit --add-readme/-g/-l/-t and reject those conflicts before any subprocess; post-create view checks hasIssuesEnabled, hasWikiEnabled, description, homepageUrl; create timeout 120s re-probes and reports exists; team and org-membership APIs use --paginate; parse_github_remote_url strips ports so ssh://git@github.com:22/... detects as gh; numbered copies match stripped origin identity while literal *_N repos do not; two-level layout stays github.com when the default host is Enterprise; non-default hosts keep host-qualified canonical refs that parse/clone/create/resolve accept; SASE_GITHUB_CLONE_TIMEOUT and onboarding hooks documented. sase tool run check 83ad10df1f4dad63cb066fcf6756e0db: 341 passed. epic-symbols: none.

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: Investigate the live Notifications modal screenshot failure — during `sase screenshot`, dismissing an unread remote-attention notification raised `NoMatches` for `#notification-file-title` in `notification_modal_attachments.py` and prevented capture.

core-repairs done in linked sase-core (crates/sase_core/src/project_onboarding/): explicit-false bools now kept in effective_options; strict mode ignores off/empty values on excluded fields but keeps real conflicts (template+gitignore=Python still errors); primary+numbered sibling merges to LOCAL with the primary path in both input orders; inventory no longer seeds rows so inventory-only identities emit nothing ref-less. Verified: sase-core 'sase tool run check' exit 0 (incl. 4 new/updated table tests); sase 'just test tests/core/test_project_onboarding_facade.py tests/project_onboarding/' 150 passed against the rebuilt extension; live-binding probe confirmed all four behaviors. No wire-shape changes, no sase-file changes, epic-symbols clean. Pin NOT moved: the core fix is uncommitted (agents never commit), so no new sase-core commit exists for sase-core-revision.txt to move past; land agent must commit in sase-core then ratchet.
